receivedPrimary.zh: 至常曾孫和，因自立為齊威王，用兵行威，大放穰苴之法，而諸侯朝齊。

p010.attribution: Regnal title 齊威王 appears in received s0047 and names the commissioner in s0048 齊威王使大夫追論…; Suoyin (三家註) reads 田和自立，至其孫，因號爲齊威王, separating 和 from his grandson 威王.

diagnosis.ownerAlignment: Retain both canonical records; do not merge p016 and p010. Owner evidence may cite substring 齊威王@s0047 but conclusions must follow the split attribution above.
